data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 街角咖啡馆的皮草大衣私语
data.description: 飘着初雪的冬日都会街角，温暖的复古咖啡馆靠窗雅座。晴奈披着厚重华贵的黑色皮草大衣，内衬紧身修身高领衫勾勒出优美身姿。她修长黑丝长腿优雅并拢，双手端起热可可瓷杯轻吹热汽。银白长发垂落，单侧黑色蝙蝠形翼轻收，转过头来向你递出一枚精致的松露巧克力，双颊泛着淡淡红晕，神情极具反差甜意。
data.action: sitting in cozy cafe booth by snowy window, luxurious black fur coat over shoulders, holding delicate porcelain cup, offering truffle chocolate with sweet teasing smile
data.location: vintage European style cafe interior with falling snow outside glass
data.lighting: warm amber cafe interior lighting contrasting with cool snowy daylight
data.mood: luxurious winter romance, sweet gourmet indulgence
data.promptProse: Seated inside a cozy vintage cafe beside a snow-dusted window, Haruna wears a lavish fur-trimmed coat draped over her shoulders. She offers a confectionary sweet with an elegant, teasing smile in warm golden light.
data.animaCaption: Haruna in a fur coat inside a snowy cafe offering a sweet treat with a charming smile.
